title.suggested: Allen Seconded "Denver Ed" Smith Against Joe Goddard

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic, noting Joe Goddard's new job as a Philadelphia matchmaker, recalled that Tom Allen coached and seconded "Denver Ed" Smith when Smith beat the favored Goddard at New Orleans.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic, Friday, December 21, 1900, page 6.

facts.fact: Allen coached and seconded "Denver Ed" Smith in his fight with Joe Goddard at New Orleans, which Smith won after a desperate fight though Goddard was an odds-on favorite

notes: Date of the Smith-Goddard fight is not given in the article. The item is about Goddard; Allen is one sentence, so focus passing.
